Because row starts include the interior offset and the three arrays may have different residues, it dynamically checks their residues, peels to a common 64-byte boundary when possible, and otherwise uses an unaligned SIMD loop. This is an alignment experiment, not an ISA assumption or a claimed speedup.

Preserve numerical tolerance and boundaries; validate and measure the kernel under the official settings.
